1 import SixVertexUnfolding.Geometry.JunctionIncomingWedges
2 import SixVertexUnfolding.Geometry.JunctionDevelopedKites
3 
4 /-! Select a junction's already constructed incident data by the actual
5 tree edge, so that path arguments need no angular-index choices. -/
6 
7 namespace SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron.JunctionFan
8 
9 open Set
10 
11 variable {P : ConvexPolyhedron} {a : frontier P.body} {T : P.CutLocusTree a}
12     {u : T.vertices} (fan : JunctionFan T u)
13 
14 /-- The unique gap ray belonging to a prescribed neighboring tree vertex. -/
15 noncomputable def edgeIndex {v : T.vertices} (edge : T.graph.Adj u v) :
16     circularGapMidpoints fan.order.angles fan.order.first fan.order.last :=
17   fan.order.neighbors.symm ⟨v, edge⟩
18 
19 theorem edgeIndex_neighbor {v : T.vertices} (edge : T.graph.Adj u v) :
20     fan.order.neighbors (fan.edgeIndex edge) = ⟨v, edge⟩ :=
21   fan.order.neighbors.apply_symm_apply _
22 
23 /-- Reindex the same two developments by their actual oriented edge. -/
24 noncomputable def edgeTriangles {v : T.vertices} (edge : T.graph.Adj u v) :
25     IncidentTriangles T edge fan.order.chart (fan.edgeIndex edge) := by
26   have data := fan.triangles (fan.edgeIndex edge)
27   simpa only [edgeIndex_neighbor] using data
28 
29 /-- Independent records in one chart with the same ray have the same incoming wedge. -/
30 theorem incoming_wedge_independent {v : T.vertices} (edge : T.graph.Adj u v)
31     (other : IncidentTriangles T edge fan.order.chart (fan.edgeIndex edge)) (ω : ℝ) :
32     other.incomingWedge ω = (fan.edgeTriangles edge).incomingWedge ω := by
33   unfold IncidentTriangles.incomingWedge
34   rw [(other.model.same_edge_corner_angles (fan.edgeTriangles edge).model).1]
35 
36 /-- Reindexing retains the incoming region of the actual angular fan. -/
37 theorem edgeTriangles_wedge {v : T.vertices} (edge : T.graph.Adj u v) (ω : ℝ) :
38     (fan.edgeTriangles edge).incomingWedge ω = (fan.triangles (fan.edgeIndex edge)).incomingWedge ω := by
39   have reindex {v w : T.vertices} {e : T.graph.Adj u v} {f : T.graph.Adj u w}
40       {θ : ℝ} (same : v = w) (data : IncidentTriangles T e fan.order.chart θ) :
41       (cast (by cases same; rfl : IncidentTriangles T e fan.order.chart θ =
42         IncidentTriangles T f fan.order.chart θ) data).incomingWedge ω = data.incomingWedge ω := by
43     cases same
44     rfl
45   exact reindex (f := edge) (congrArg Subtype.val (fan.edgeIndex_neighbor edge))
46     (fan.triangles (fan.edgeIndex edge))
47 
48 /-- Reindexing also retains the two complete triangle images. -/
49 theorem edgeTriangles_kite {v : T.vertices} (edge : T.graph.Adj u v) :
50     (fan.edgeTriangles edge).developedKite = (fan.triangles (fan.edgeIndex edge)).developedKite := by
51   have reindex {v w : T.vertices} {e : T.graph.Adj u v} {f : T.graph.Adj u w}
52       {θ : ℝ} (same : v = w) (data : IncidentTriangles T e fan.order.chart θ) :
53       (cast (by cases same; rfl : IncidentTriangles T e fan.order.chart θ =
54         IncidentTriangles T f fan.order.chart θ) data).developedKite = data.developedKite := by
55     cases same
56     rfl
57   exact reindex (f := edge) (congrArg Subtype.val (fan.edgeIndex_neighbor edge))
58     (fan.triangles (fan.edgeIndex edge))
59 
60 end SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron.JunctionFan
